notes: The panel no longer jumps height after the loader appears. The previous build was meant to open the window at the loading height, but it checked the app-wide theme rather than the theme of the panel being opened - so for the OG widget it…

Removed the second fade. The OG widget has its own reflow cover that blanks every row and restores it a quarter second later, and the weather arriving just after the loader finished was triggering it - so the contents faded in, out, and in…

The first loader word no longer arrives late. It was being crossfaded in like a rotation, so it appeared a third of a second after the loader itself. There is nothing to fade from on the first word; it is now painted immediately.
